evaluation: 8-fold leave-one-subject-out; each subject is outer test exactly once
neural_inner_validation: Next subject in cyclic subject order; never the outer test subject
neural_final_refit: Reinitialize with the same fold seed and train on all 7 outer-training subjects for the selected number of epochs
class_weights: inverse square root of training-only class counts, normalized to mean 1
primary_metric: macro F1 over the 12 prespecified activity labels (zero_division=0)
secondary_metrics: subject-wise mean and sample standard deviation
notes: Fixed before outcome inspection. LOSO is model assessment, not a separate untouched final test. No hyperparameters are changed after observing outer scores. Pure-activity offline windows exclude transitions.
